variants.name: Current architecture
variants.summary: System level: the running applications and storage behind archboard. Current source as inspected 2026-09-13; drill into each application for its internal modules.

nodes.name: Agent CLI
nodes.description: A short-lived Bun process. Validated semantic commands reach the canvas over HTTP; it does not write vault files itself.

nodes.name: Canvas server
nodes.description: One Bun/Express process owns board persistence, rendering, HTTP and WebSocket delivery. Its embedded Codex workbench is explained separately on the workbench service board.

nodes.name: Browser
nodes.description: The desktop browser owns presentation: panes, camera, selection and walkthrough position. Board content is fetched from the server.

nodes.name: Board vault
nodes.description: Permanent repo-local .archboard/vault. One .semantic.json per board holds current, draft and historical variants; accepted writes land atomically.

nodes.name: Codex app-server
nodes.description: A separate private child process owned by the canvas. The linked workhorse and voice coordinator are separate threads. Follow the link to the archboard integration, not Codex internals.

nodes.name: Repository checkout
nodes.description: Code bindings use portable repository identities plus relative paths. A machine-local registry resolves them to this checkout.

beats.heading: One owner of board content
beats.body: Agents submit meaning through the CLI. The canvas checks writes and commits the whole board family before announcing it.

beats.heading: People explore server-rendered views
beats.body: The browser requests a rendered view and owns the camera and selection. It re-reads after board announcements.

beats.heading: Agent execution has a separate lifetime
beats.body: The canvas owns a private Codex child. The integration handles thread links, context and approvals; code bindings resolve against registered checkouts.
